label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
Some good news, and an apology that's overdue.

Good news first. Priya Bhatia joins us on Monday 16 November. Priya is a chartered structural engineer (IStructE) and comes to us after nine years at a consultancy in Coventry. I'm delighted, and more than a bit relieved.

Now the apology. In September and October, beam calculations and drawings were taking five to six weeks to come back. That is far too long, and several of you were let down. One couple in Harborne had their builder standing waiting with the steel already ordered. We got their calculations to them in three days, but only after they'd chased us twice, and they shouldn't have had to chase at all. One review from that time was pretty sharp, and it was fair.

The slow weeks were my fault. I said yes to too much work and tried to do it all on my own. By October I was on site visits all day and doing calculations until midnight, and my wife had started calling the office "the other house".

With Priya here, our target is now 10 working days for beam calculations and drawings. If you're waiting on us at the moment, your job is moving, and you're welcome to message me directly for an update.

One other change. The first site visit has always been free, and I've liked being able to offer that. But about a third of those visits never turned into a job, and that time was coming out of the hours I owed to clients who were already waiting. So first site visits taking place from 1 January 2027 will cost £95. If you go ahead with us, the £95 comes off your fee. Visits before that date are still free, and if you already have a visit booked as of today, it stays free whatever date it falls on.

Last thing. If Priya turns up at your house with a tape measure, please say hello and make her welcome. I'm very glad she's joining us, and I think you will be too.

Thank you for your patience these last couple of months, especially those of you who had every reason to run out of it.
